name: SnowSignals
description: SnowSignals — market-data platform (data-as-a-service). TrendVane multi-timeframe market-phase (regime) classifications for crypto, over a metered API and an MCP server. State, not trade signals.

apis.name: SnowSignals TrendVane daas API
apis.description: Metered, prepaid market-phase (regime) classifications per currency and timeframe — closed-bar and intra-bar — plus a free, no-auth BTC-derived phase-resolution model (successor-transition probabilities, trend-continuation, MFE/MAE, with sample counts). Reports market state, not signals.
